series.name: S6-EH3P(5-10)K-H / (12-20)K-H / (29.9-50)K-H (three-phase hybrid + high-voltage battery)
series.notes: Third code dialect: the LCD prints the plain text name, but the SolisAI APP alarm page prints a SEPARATE numeric 'Alarm Code' plus an 'Alarm Grade' (EMGR = emergency, Hint = informational). The screenshot in the manual shows 'Alarm Message: HeartbeatLose / Alarm Code: 1065 / Alarm Grade: EMGR'. The fault table itself still uses the S5 hybrid NAME (10xx DATA:xxxx) form. This block must NOT be merged with SERIES 1/2 (on-grid 10xx means different things) nor with SERIES 4 (single-phase 48 V hybrid).

title.ur: HeartbeatLose, yaani parallel link kho gaya (APP code 1065, grade EMGR)

meaning.en: The parallel communication heartbeat between S6-EH3P units is lost, so the redundant group shut down.
meaning.ur: S6-EH3P units ke darmiyan parallel communication heartbeat kho gaya, is liye redundant group band ho gaya.

causes.en: The connection between the parallel communication wire is not normal
causes.ur: Parallel communication wire ka connection normal nahi hai

causes.en: Master address not set to 1, or two units left set as master
causes.ur: Master ka address 1 par set nahi, ya do units master hi chhor diye gaye

solutions.en: Power down the group and check the parallel communication cable: shielded, 8-core, seated at both P-A and P-B terminals.
solutions.ur: Group power down karke parallel communication cable check karein: shielded, 8-core, P-A aur P-B dono terminals par fit.

solutions.en: Verify there is a master inverter in the parallel system and confirm its address is set to 1, then confirm the DIP switch settings of every unit.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke parallel system mein master inverter hai aur uska address 1 par set hai, phir har unit ke DIP switch settings confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restart the system and confirm whether the fault continues; if it does not clear, contact the manufacturer's customer service - do not keep power cycling.
solutions.ur: System restart karke dekhein ke fault rehta hai ya nahi; hat na aaye to manufacturer ke customer service se rabta karein - baar baar power cycle na karein.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

title.ur: Battery ka hardware overvoltage ya VBUS rail par protection (1051)

meaning.en: The high-voltage battery hardware overvoltage protection tripped, so the S6-EH3P has locked out.
meaning.ur: High-voltage battery ka hardware overvoltage protection trigger ho gaya, is liye S6-EH3P lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Battery circuit breaker tripping under charge
causes.ur: Charge ke waqt battery circuit breaker trip ho raha hai

causes.en: Battery pack damaged or a cell overcharged in the 150-800 V pack
causes.ur: Battery pack damaged hai ya 150-800 V pack mein koi cell overcharge ho gaya

solutions.en: Check if the battery circuit breaker is tripping: watch the breaker while the unit is charging and note whether it trips at a repeatable SoC.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery circuit breaker trip to nahi ho raha: unit charge karte waqt breaker par nazar rakhein aur note karein ke kisi khaas SoC par repeat hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the pack voltage at the inverter battery port with a multimeter and compare it with the BMS value in SolisCloud; a large gap points to wiring or BMS.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter battery port par pack voltage measure karein aur SolisCloud ke BMS value se compare karein; bara farq wiring ya BMS ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Check if the battery is damaged: if the breaker is healthy and the pack reads over-voltage, have the battery vendor test the pack before condemning the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery damaged hai ya nahi: breaker theek hai aur pack over-voltage parha raha hai to inverter kharab karne se pehle battery vendor se pack test karwa lein.

notes.en: For the (29.9-50)K-H the battery range is 150-800 V with two battery inputs and CAN/RS485, so a battery overvoltage here is a HV event, not the 42-58 V event of the RHI / S5-EH1P-L.
notes.ur: (29.9-50)K-H mein battery range 150-800 V hai aur do battery inputs hain, CAN/RS485 ke saath, is liye yahan battery overvoltage ek HV event hai, RHI / S5-EH1P-L wale 42-58 V event nahi.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

title.ur: Volt-Watt ke tehat power limit lagay huay (LmtByVg)

meaning.en: Because the grid voltage is high, the inverter has automatically reduced output under the Volt-Watt response curve required by the local safety rules.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage zyada hone ki wajah se inverter ne local safety rules ke mutabiq Volt-Watt response curve ke tehat output khud kam kar diya.

causes.en: Local safety regulations require Volt-Watt when grid voltage is high
causes.ur: Local safety regulations grid voltage zyada hone par Volt-Watt maangte hain

causes.en: Factory test mode left enabled after commissioning
causes.ur: Commissioning ke baad factory test mode on chhor diya gaya

solutions.en: No action needed - this is a normal safety response to high grid voltage.
solutions.ur: Koi action nahi chahiye - grid voltage zyada hone par ye normal safety response hai.

solutions.en: If you need to close the mode: Main menu > Advanced Settings > Password 0010 > STD mode settings > Working Mode > Working mode: NULL > Save and exit.
solutions.ur: Agar mode band karna ho to: Main menu > Advanced Settings > Password 0010 > STD mode settings > Working Mode > Working mode: NULL > Save and exit.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

aliases: Off grid status to On grid status

title.en: Syncing from off-grid back to grid (StandbySynoch)
title.ur: Off-grid se grid par wapas sync ho raha hai (StandbySynoch)

meaning.en: The inverter is holding in standby and waiting for the grid to come back so it can resynchronise voltage, phase and frequency.
meaning.ur: Inverter standby mein hai aur grid aane ka intezaar kar raha hai taake voltage, phase aur frequency dobara match kar sake.

causes.en: Grid outage that has now ended
causes.ur: Grid ka outage jo ab khatam ho gaya

causes.en: Generator made the grid and the inverter is re-checking phase sequence
causes.ur: Generator ne grid chala diya aur inverter phase sequence dobara check kar raha hai

solutions.en: No action needed - the device is in normal operation while it resynchronises.
solutions.ur: Koi action nahi chahiye - device resync hone tak normal chal raha hai.

solutions.en: If it stays in StandbySynoch for more than a few minutes, measure grid voltage and frequency at the AC terminal to confirm the grid is inside the allowed window.
solutions.ur: Agar kai minute se zyada StandbySynoch par raha ho to AC terminal par grid voltage aur frequency measure karke confirm karein ke grid allowed window ke andar hai.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

title.ur: Grid se load par transfer ho raha hai (GridToLoad)

meaning.en: The inverter has detected a grid event and is switching its output from grid-tied mode to the load/backup path.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne grid par koi event detect kiya hai aur apna output grid-tied mode se load/backup path par switch kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid loss, voltage sag or frequency excursion starting
causes.ur: Grid loss, voltage sag ya frequency excursion shuru hona

solutions.en: No action needed; the transfer is automatic.
solutions.ur: Koi action nahi chahiye; transfer automatic hai.

solutions.en: If the transfer fails or the unit trips on switch-over, check the generator input phase sequence matches the grid L1-L2-L3 order.
solutions.ur: Agar transfer fail ho ya switch-over par unit trip kare to generator input ka phase sequence grid ke L1-L2-L3 order se match karta hai check karein.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

title.ur: Battery LED se pata chalta hai pack charge, discharge, idle ya alarm mein hai

meaning.en: Colour and breathing direction of the Battery LED tell you which pack is charging, discharging, idle or in alarm.
meaning.ur: Battery LED ka rang aur breathing direction batata hai ke kaun sa pack charge ho raha hai, discharge ho raha hai, idle hai ya alarm mein hai.

causes.en: Normal battery state indication on the front panel
causes.ur: Front panel par battery ka normal halat dikhaya jana

causes.en: Battery 1 or 2 is in alarm when the LED turns yellow
causes.ur: LED yellow ho jaye to Battery 1 ya 2 alarm halat mein hai

solutions.en: Read the pack state in the app: with a yellow Battery LED, check each pack's SoC and BMS status on the APP alarm page.
solutions.ur: App mein pack state padhein: Battery LED yellow ho to APP alarm page par har pack ka SoC aur BMS status check karein.

solutions.en: If the LED is OFF while a pack is fitted, check that the battery breaker is closed and the battery model is not set to 'No Battery'.
solutions.ur: Agar pack lage hone par bhi LED OFF ho to battery breaker band hai aur battery model 'No Battery' par to nahi, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: Note that battery/WiFi/Ethernet/Bluetooth indicators turn off after 1 minute to save power; short-press the Power LED to wake them again.
solutions.ur: Yeh yaad rakhein ke battery/WiFi/Ethernet/Bluetooth indicators 1 minute baad power bachane ke liye band ho jate hain; dobara jaganey ke liye Power LED par short-press karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Blue breathing = Battery 1 charging; Green breathing = Battery 2 charging; Blue breathing in reverse = Battery 1 discharging; Green breathing in reverse = Battery 2 discharging; Blue solid = Battery 1 idle; Green solid = Battery 2 idle; Yellow solid = Battery 1 alarm; Yellow flashing = Battery 2 alarm; OFF = no battery

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

title.ur: Power LED se normal chalna, warning ya alarm pata chalta hai

meaning.en: Blue solid means the inverter is running normally, yellow solid is a warning, and red solid or red flashing every 3 s is an alarm you must read in the app.
meaning.ur: Blue solid ka matlab inverter normal chal raha hai, yellow solid warning hai, aur red solid ya har 3 second par red flashing alarm hai jo app mein padhna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Alarm present - the manual says to connect by Bluetooth tool to determine the alarm code
causes.ur: Alarm mojood - manual ke mutabiq Bluetooth tool se connect karke alarm code pata karein

solutions.en: If the LED is red, connect to the inverter with the Bluetooth tool and read the alarm code; the LED alone does not identify the fault.
solutions.ur: Agar LED red ho to Bluetooth tool se inverter se connect karke alarm code padhein; LED akela fault nahi batata.

solutions.en: The Power indicator stays on at lower brightness after the other LEDs sleep; short-press it to wake all indicators.
solutions.ur: Baaki LEDs sone ke baad Power indicator kam brightness par on rehta hai; sab indicators jaganey ke liye us par short-press karein.

solutions.en: If a Table 7.1 fault is showing, switch the inverter off and wait 5 minutes before restarting, per the manual note.
solutions.ur: Agar Table 7.1 ka koi fault aa raha ho to manual ke note ke mutabiq inverter band karke 5 minute wait karein phir restart karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Blue solid ON = normally operating; Yellow solid ON = warning; Red solid ON or flashing every 3s = alarm

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description
